Tier2 svg conversion with accessible names enabled

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert_with_accessible_names;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p><svg aria-label="Name"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>"#;
    let use_accessible_names = true;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"inline_data_media":"AltTextOnly","tier_strategy":"tier2"}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert_with_accessible_names(html, use_accessible_names, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
